beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Bismuth in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Workshops filed this pretty crystalline metal with lead, tin, or antimony until an eighteenth-century chemist showed that its reactions were its own.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Bismuth in this catalog?
options: A German Name of Uncertain Origin
beginner.explanation: The word arrived from German mining speech, and scholars still do not share one settled story about the older phrase inside it.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Bismuth in this catalog?
options: The Stable Element That Was Not
beginner.explanation: Textbooks once called this the last stable element, until a very slow decay showed that the final natural isotope does break down.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Bismuth in this catalog?
options: An Alloy That Melts in Hot Water
beginner.explanation: A workshop alloy of this metal lets go at a temperature hot water can reach, which put it into fuses and fire-sprinkler links.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Bismuth in this catalog?
options: The Pink Bottle in the Cabinet
beginner.explanation: A familiar medicine for an upset stomach is built on a compound of this metal, a household role far from any medieval mine.
